title: Tidebound
tagline: A cozy, vibrant 2D platform adventure guiding Cori the Reef Sprite to reignite the Great Horizon Beacon
description: Dive into the sun-kissed islands of Tidebound as Cori the Reef Sprite! A mysterious ocean storm has extinguished the ancient island beacons and awakened the colossal Tide Golem. Leap across 5 interconnected island biomes, master the hydro-dynamic Tide Dash, stomp quirky coastal pests, meet friendly seafaring locals, collect all 25 Sun Pearls and 5 Secret Lore Medallions, and reignite all four Great Lighthouses to restore peace to the archipelago.
howToPlay:
Desktop Controls:
- [A] / [D] or [Arrow Keys]: Run Left / Right
- [Space] / [W] / [Up Arrow]: Jump (Variable jump height on key hold)
- [Shift] / [J] / [X]: Tide Dash (Air hydro dash, resets on landing/enemy stomp)
- [S] / [Down Arrow]: Crouch / Fast Fall / Drop Through One-Way Ledges
- [E] / [Enter]: Talk to NPCs & Attune Waystone Sanctuaries
- [Esc] / [P]: Pause Game
- Stomp enemies by landing on them to bounce skyward and reset your Tide Dash!

Mobile Controls:
- Virtual D-Pad for directional running & crouch/drop
- On-screen touch buttons for Jump, Tide Dash, and Talk/Interact.
features: 5 Hand-crafted Coastal Biomes (Tropical Reef, Sunken Coral Ruins, Bioluminescent Grotto, Tempest Cliffs, Ancient Horizon Beacon)
Fluid Kinetic Movement with Variable Jump, Coyote Time, Jump Buffer, and Hydro Tide Dash
Engaging Enemy Stomp Combat with 4 Marine Archetypes (Hermit Scuttler, Spiny Urchin, Bubble Ray, Coral Crab)
Multi-Phase Boss Encounter with the Ancient Tide Golem (Tidal Waves, Rock Boulders, Dazed Vulnerability Stomp)
25 Sun Pearls, 50 Nautilus Shells, 5 Secret Lore Medallions, and 4 Reignitable Lighthouses
3 Expressive Seafaring NPCs (Coralia the Diver, Barnaby the Navigator, Ancient Beacon Keeper) with Rich Dialogue
100% Procedural Web Audio Synthesizer with Dynamic Biome Chiptunes and Custom Sound FX
On-Screen Audio Mute Control, Automatic Tab Visibility Pausing, and Responsive Canvas Scaling
Persistent Save System with Playgama Cloud Sync and Local Storage Fallbacks
Pure Plain JS Architecture with Zero External Dependencies or Prohibited Analytics
